# Niche

> > Niche is a comprehensive platform helping students and families discover and research K-12 schools, colleges, and places to live through rankings, reviews, and data-driven insights.

Niche provides educational resources covering college admissions tools like Niche Direct Admissions and Niche's True Cost Tool, alongside marketing solutions such as the Niche Pixel for enrollment conversion tracking. The platform serves students, parents, and educational institutions with guidance on school selection, standardized testing (SAT/ACT), and enrollment decisions.

## Key Topics

- Niche Direct Admissions
- Niche's True Cost Tool
- Niche Pixel
- K-12 Schools
- College Admissions
- SAT and ACT
- Boarding Schools
- Student Guidance
- Parent Resources
- Conversion Tracking
- Google Tag Manager (GTM)
- Attribution Models
- Monthly Insights Report
- Bachelor of Arts and Bachelor of Science Programs
